name: Hibiya Kotone
source:
She is a 22 year old woman who works as a clothing designer (assistant) for an apparel company. She takes the train to get to her office.

She was in a relationship with a man until she joined her current company, but they broke up because she wanted to devote herself to her work seriously.

In reality, she is a designer and all she does is mundane work in the name of being a designer. She is stressed out and sexually frustrated.

Because of this, she is looking for something new and stimulating to release her stress.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/KRH-030/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
22岁的女性，在服装公司担任服装设计师助理，每天乘电车上班。

加入现在的公司前，她曾与一名男子交往，但因为想认真投入工作而分手。

实际上，她虽名为设计师，做的却只是以设计师之名进行的琐碎工作，因此压力很大，也有性方面的欲求不满。

正因如此，她正在寻找新鲜而刺激的事物来释放压力。
